title: PANAX Group
description:
# PANAX GROUP / UKSEUNG Chemical (욱성화학) — South Korea

**Industry:** Chemical Manufacturing, Industrial Automation (SCADA/PCS7), Nuclear Infrastructure Supplier
**Revenue:** ~$141M USD/year (Group Total)
**Headquarters:** Busan, South Korea
**Websites:** ukseung.co.kr | panaxworld.com | panaxholdings.co.kr
**Employees:** 679 (Active Directory)

---

## About

PANAX GROUP is a South Korean industrial conglomerate based in Busan, operating since 1969. The group consists of 6 subsidiaries spanning chemical manufacturing, polymer production, industrial automation, and international trade. Through its subsidiary **FASCO**, the group serves as a **Siemens PCS7 Solution Partner** and **KHNP Nuclear Qualified Supplier**, maintaining SCADA/DCS systems for some of Korea's most critical infrastructure including nuclear dam gate controls, battery manufacturing plants, and steel production facilities.

### Group Structure:
- **UKSEUNG Chemical (욱성화학)** — Organic pigments, resins, coatings
- **BUSEONG POLYCOM (부성폴리콤)** — Polymer/chemical
- **ETEC (이텍)** — Technology
- **FASCO (파스코)** — Factory automation, SCADA integration
- **PANAX Energy** — Energy services
- **UK Seung Europe** — European trade operations



---

## Data Exfiltrated

The complete digital infrastructure of PANAX GROUP has been compromised. The following data has been collected and verified:

### Active Directory — Complete Domain Dump

Full NTDS.dit extraction containing **679 user accounts** and **784 computer accounts** across **6 corporate domains**:
- panaxworld.com (Primary)
- panax.local
- ukseung.co.kr
- efasco.co.kr
- panaxetec.co.kr
- panaxenergy.co.kr

Includes Domain Administrator, krbtgt, CFO, and all privileged accounts. 235 accounts use the same default password.



### Network Infrastructure

Complete internal network mapping covering 12+ subnets. Key servers identified:
- SQL Server (ERP) with SA credentials
- File Servers
- SCADA Project Server
- Backup Server
- Multiple Domain Controllers
- Hyper-V Cluster

No network segmentation between IT and OT/SCADA environments.



### SCADA / Industrial Control Systems

**FASCO maintains SCADA/DCS systems for major Korean industrial clients:**

| Client | Sector | System |
|---|---|---|
| **Samsung SDI (삼성SDI)** | Battery Manufacturing | PCS7 Air Compressor Control |
| **Hyundai Steel (현대제철)** | Steel Production | PLC Replacement |
| **KHNP (한국수력원자력)** | **Nuclear — Dam Gate Control** | PCS7 DCS |
| **EcoPro (에코프로)** | Battery Materials | Inverter Control |
| **LG Chem (LG화학)** | Chemical | DCS Maintenance |
| **POSCO** | Steel/Energy | Substation Monitoring |
| **Celltrion (셀트리온)** | Pharmaceutical | Crater Project |

Active SCADA credentials recovered — including operator accounts with **full plant control** capability, engineer accounts, WinCC HMI passwords, and PCS7 virtual machine images with empty Administrator passwords.


### Nuclear Infrastructure

FASCO is a **KHNP (Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power) certified supplier** for nuclear facility I&C systems. Recovered documents include:

- **Cheongpyeong Dam (청평댐)** — Complete gate control CFC program, HMI configuration, password modification records
- **Goesan Dam (괴산댐)** — Gate control logic including Intake Gate #1, #2 and Tunnel Gate position control
- Siemens PCS7 Solution Partner Certificate
- KHNP Qualified Supplier certificates (JSC01, EPL01)
- Technical specifications for water intake pump monitoring/control systems
- Contracts and cost estimates for nuclear facility work



### Financial Data — Complete Banking Access

Corporate bank accounts across 8 Korean banks with PINs and internet banking passwords:
- 국민은행 (KB Kookmin)
- 농협 (NH)
- 부산은행 (Busan Bank)
- 산업은행 (KDB)
- 신한은행 (Shinhan)
- 우리은행 (Woori)
- 중소기업은행 (IBK)
- 하나은행 (Hana)

Includes corporate transfer PINs, certificate passwords, and payroll accounts.


### Government Portal Access

Active credentials for Korean government and financial systems:

- **HomeTax (국세청)** — National Tax Service
- **UNIPASS (관세청)** — Customs Service
- **KRX (한국거래소)** — Korea Exchange (Securities)
- **KIBO (기술보증기금)** — Technology Guarantee Fund
- **KSURE (무역보험공사)** — Trade Insurance
- **NICE / KED** — Credit Rating agencies
- **Statistics Korea** — Government statistics
- Multiple banking portals


### SQL Server & ERP Databases

Direct SA access to the ERP database server. Multiple databases containing complete business operations — financials, customer data, trade records, inventory management, material tracking, HR information, and quality control spanning years of operations.


### Digital Certificates & NPKI Keys

Corporate PFX certificates for corporate signing, tax filing, and banking — including UKSEUNG Chemical corporate certificates, PANAX financial certificates, executive personal certificates, and BizBank approval certificates.

**NPKI (National PKI) private keys** — used for legally binding digital signatures in Korean government and financial systems.

### Personal Identification Documents

Executive identification documents including Chairman passport, CEO national ID card, and 15+ executives' passports, driver licenses, and national ID cards.

**Korean national ID numbers (주민등록번호)** — permanent, non-replaceable national identifiers — exposed for multiple executives and employees.


### Employee & Supply Chain Data

- Employee records — names, departments, personal bank accounts, national ID numbers
- Vendor bank accounts — complete supply chain payment records
- Domestic business partners with registration numbers and contacts
- International trade partners across 12+ countries
- Employee phone directory
- Email archives from trade and procurement departments



### File Server

Complete corporate file server contents spanning all departments — Finance, HR, Sales, R&D, Safety, Production. Includes financial records, trade correspondence, chemical formulation data, contracts, NDAs, insurance records, loan documents, safety department credentials, and chemical management system data.

## Impact Assessment

| Category | Risk Level |
|---|---|
| SCADA/ICS Credentials | **NATIONAL SECURITY** |
| Nuclear Dam Controls | **NATIONAL SECURITY** |
| Korean SSN (주민번호) | **CRITICAL** |
| Banking + Transfer PINs | **CRITICAL** |
| Government Portal Access | **CRITICAL** |
| AD Domain Dump | **CRITICAL** |
| ERP Databases | **CRITICAL** |
| Digital Certificates + NPKI Keys | **CRITICAL** |
| Employee PII + Bank Accounts | **HIGH** |
| Vendor Payment Records | **HIGH** |
| Executive IDs (Passports, Licenses) | **HIGH** |
| Corporate File Server | **HIGH** |

### Regulatory Exposure:
- **PIPA (개인정보보호법)** — Korean Personal Information Protection Act
- **K-ISMS (정보보호관리체계)** — Information Security Management System
- **산업기술보호법** — Industrial Technology Protection Act
- **전자금융거래법** — Electronic Financial Transactions Act
- **원자력안전법** — Nuclear Safety Act

---

## Affected Third Parties

The breach extends beyond PANAX GROUP to their industrial clients whose SCADA configurations, project files, and control system access are included in the exfiltrated data:

- Samsung SDI
- Hyundai Steel
- Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power (KHNP)
- EcoPro
- LG Chem
- POSCO / POSCO E&C / POSCO DX
- Celltrion
- Air Liquide
- Korea Western Power
- Narae Energy Service
